intro: Gart Mistrunner is the resident druid trainer stationed at Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa. He welcomes novice tauren called by the Earth Mother and guides them through their first rites of nature magic.

sections.t: Mentor of the Red Cloud Mesa
p: Standing watch over Camp Narache, Gart Mistrunner represents the ancient druidic path rekindled among the Shu'halo. New tauren druids are directed straight to Gart upon taking their first steps on the Red Cloud Mesa, often carrying a verdant note commending them into his care. Through his patient guidance, young practitioners learn to commune with the natural world, drawing upon the restorative powers of nature and the lunar radiance of Mu'sha to heal their allies and strike down threats to the land.
